mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with donepezil (acetylcholinesterase inhibitor) increases cholinergic activity, risking serotonergic syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and excessive parasympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use with extreme caution under close monitoring for hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and cholinergic toxicity symptoms.
